name: Black Diamond
description:
Connect Claude to Black Diamond and get answers from your data in plain language, without switching screens or running manual lookups.

Look up clients and accounts, pull performance and holdings down to the tax lot, track private fund activity, and review fees and transactions. Find rebalancing and tax loss harvesting opportunities, launch rebalance sessions, and run client reports on demand.

Built for advisors and operations teams prepping for client meetings, researching billing questions, or scanning the book for opportunities.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Black Diamond to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Black Diamond to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://bd3.bdreporting.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Black Diamond MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Black Diamond provides these MCP tools: blackdiamond_ask_data_warehouse, blackdiamond_get_navigation_links, blackdiamond_get_user_context, blackdiamond_invoke_tool, blackdiamond_search_help_documentation, and blackdiamond_search_tools.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Black Diamond?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Black Diamond in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.

_published_faq.name: Does Black Diamond MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Black Diamond requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Black Diamond is developed by SS&C Black Diamond. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
